voice-branch-jargon.notes: Fixed. The "### CI enforcement" heading is now "### Validation" and the warn-only / --strict / --strict-wired CI modes and the witness-pipeline.yml reference are gone; what the validator actually checks (dual fields present on every LP/SDP/operator-selection witness) is kept, as is the validator script citation. "enforced in CI" is dropped from the opening. The closing Notes no longer instruct a maintainer to run the validator and no longer call the paper "the corpus"; they now state plainly that not every LP/SDP witness yet carries its dual and that no count is quoted because it changes. The 58-of-58 historical figure is untouched.
